purpose: Produce a concise independent Research Library view of an already-formed current candidate without allowing research to manufacture or silently rewrite the live recommendation.
construction: Form the provisional current handicap from current evidence before applying Research Library History Fit.
Identify candidate sport/league, market class, timing state, selection role/threshold and key mechanism.
Retrieve the smallest relevant set of canonical items; normally 1-4 primary priors plus at most one synthesis/inference item when useful.
Use evidence clusters to prevent double-counting related studies or resolution summaries.
Assess evidence tier, confidence, directness, era transportability, market match and material contrary evidence.
Render History Fit as verdict + mechanism + main limitation/evidence-quality note.

gradeScale.A: Strong direct research fit with high applicability and no material unresolved contrary evidence.
gradeScale.B: Supportive research fit with caveats, indirectness, era limits or meaningful contrary evidence.
gradeScale.C: Mixed, neutral or indirect research fit; conflicting or weakly transportable evidence.
gradeScale.D: Research is materially cautionary/contrary to the candidate structure.
gradeScale.NR: No reliable direct prior or the applicable literature is an explicit gap.

modifiers: +/- may be used for communication, not pseudo-precision.

textBudget.exceptionRule: Longer than about 50 words should be exceptional.

conflictRules: A source repeated across a primary prior, question resolution or gap resolution counts once.
Synthesis and inference retrieval roles are never additional independent evidence votes.
Direct sport/market/timing evidence outranks generic cross-sport analogy.
Later replication that weakens an old threshold does not erase the old finding; it lowers transportability and must appear as a caveat.
High-quality direct conflicts normally lower History Fit toward C unless applicability clearly favors one side.
A research gap produces NR, not a negative predictive claim.
Movement-information and movement-overreaction findings are treated as horizon/path tension, not a simplistic contradiction.
Do not trend-shop, cherry-pick periods, or retrieve by desired outcome.

failureMode.effect: Current analysis may proceed if all core report gates pass; History Fit is unavailable rather than fabricated.

evidenceUseRules.A_B_C_primary: May inform the research-side strength/applicability judgment for History Fit, subject to cluster deduplication and transportability.
evidenceUseRules.D_primary: Context/caution only; do not elevate History Fit solely because of practitioner, official/descriptive, integrity-case, or microstructure evidence.
evidenceUseRules.GAP: Supports NR/local-gap conclusions; it is not predictive negative evidence.
evidenceUseRules.SYNTHESIS: Interpretive summary only; never double-count with underlying evidence.
evidenceUseRules.INFERENCE: Design/caution only; not empirical study evidence.
